Class MapRenderer

java.lang.Object
echoshift.UI.MapRenderer
public class MapRenderer extends Object
This class creates the visuals for the map and the enemy tracker.

      public void addEntity(Entity entity)
      This class add the visual representation of the enemy to the game screen. The Entity is always on the screen but invisible unless the canner is active.
      Parameters:
      entity - The enemy of the game level.

    • endScan

      public void endScan()
      This class sets the opacity of the entity to zero. It is used when the scanner time runs out.
